strings.note: Market reading card (hover panel), a bottle's property row, joined to its neighbours by ' · '. {rung} is the bottle's tier 1-4, {top} is 4. Sentence case; the row holds ~46 characters in all.
Market reading card, bottle property row, after ' · '. {abv} is the strength as a number (e.g. 40 or 12.5). Short.
Market reading card, bottle property row, only for a bottle already on the shelf. {percent} is a whole number 0-100. ~30 characters.
Market tile's small meta line after the style word and ' · ' (e.g. 'Vodka · 40%'). {abv} is the strength. Keep tiny: the tile line is ~20 characters, 8 px face.
Market reading card body for a bottle. {drinks} is a comma-separated list of up to five drink names on tonight's menu. Wraps; one sentence.
Market reading card body for a keg of beer that no drink on the menu uses. One short sentence.

strings.text: No drink on the book calls for it yet.
strings.note: Market reading card body for a bottle no menu drink uses. One sentence.

strings.text: {n} drink on the menu call for it
strings.note: Market reading card effect line (blue pour icon). {n} is how many menu drinks use this bottle (1-5). English text kept exactly as shipped. One line, ~40 characters.

strings.text: {n} drinks on the menu call for it
strings.note: As market.bottle.menu_calls#one.

strings.text: Nothing on tonight's menu calls for it
strings.note: Market reading card effect line (red lock icon) for a bottle no menu drink uses. One line, ~40 characters.

strings.text: Joins the shelf; the well bottle stays
strings.note: Market reading card effect line (green star icon) for a premium bottle: buying it adds a bottle, the cheap house bottle is not replaced. One line.

strings.text: A small bottle — {measures} measures, half a spirit's
strings.note: Market reading card effect line (coin icon) for a mixer. {measures} is the mixer bottle's capacity in measures (e.g. 6). One line, ~50 characters.
Market tile foot word where the price was, after the order bought it. Capitals, 16 px shop face, 70 px wide: 4 characters, never 5.
Caption on a market tile's small key when the item is already in the basket (click removes it). Capitals, 8 px face, ~70 px key, two short lines at most.
Caption on a market tile's small key: a room upgrade, but tonight's one upgrade is already used or picked. Capitals, 8 px face, ~70 px key.
Caption on a market tile's small key, in red: the till cannot pay for it. Capitals, 8 px face, ~70 px key.
Caption on a market tile's small key: put this in the basket. Capitals, 8 px face, ~70 px key.
Generic word for a drinking glass when a recipe's glass is not found; completes a phrase like 'served in a glass' on the recipe book listing. Lower case.
Upgrade screen reading card, glassware line: after 'Rung 2 of 5 · ', says no drink on the menu is served in this glass. Capitals.
Upgrade screen reading card, glassware line: after 'Rung 2 of 5 · '. {drinks} is a comma-separated list of up to four drink names in capitals. Only the sentence's closing punctuation is text here.
Reading card under the pointer on a basket chip. {price} is the price with its sign (e.g. '$38'). One line.

strings.text: Click to take it back out. You only pay when you place the order.
strings.note: Reading card body on a basket chip. Wraps in a ~260 px card.
Reading card title on the '+N' chip at the end of a full basket row. {n} is how many picked items the row could not show. Capitals, one line.
As market.basket.more_identity#one.
Reading card second line on the '+N' basket chip. Lower case, one line.

strings.text: The row is full, the basket is not. Everything you picked is in the total.
strings.note: Reading card body on the '+N' basket chip. Wraps.
Toast when the player tries to put a second room upgrade in the basket. Capitals, one line.
Toast when the basket would cost more than the till holds. Capitals, one line.
Toast when the order key is pressed with nothing picked. Capitals, one line.
Toast when checkout stops because the shop refused one line. {item} is that item's listing name as the tile names it (not upper-cased). One line.
Market foot key caption for ~3 s after the order is placed (key greyed). Capitals, 8 px face, 136 px key holds 2 lines. PlayMode test asserts this English.
Market foot key caption when the basket has something in it. Capitals, two lines split by the newline, 136 px key. PlayMode test asserts this English.
Market foot key caption with an empty basket at the end of a week (the next night is Tuesday). Capitals, two lines, 136 px key.
Market foot key caption with an empty basket: ends the market and opens the next night. Capitals, two lines, 136 px key.
Internal listing name of a sealed crate (basket label fallback; normally hidden behind its title). {n} is how many items in this aisle are still locked.
As market.gate.more_waiting#one.
Tag under the count on a sealed crate tile whose items wait on something other than stars. Capitals, 8 px face, ~150 px tag.
Reading card title on the liquor aisle's sealed crate: more bottles unlock by events, not stars. Capitals, one line ~30 characters.
Reading card title on the liquor aisle's sealed crate. {stars} is the nearest star rating that unlocks more (e.g. 3.5). Capitals, one line.

strings.text: {n} bottle the van will not bring you yet
strings.note: Reading card second line on the liquor aisle's sealed crate. {n} is how many bottles are locked. One line.

strings.text: {n} bottles the van will not bring you yet
strings.note: As market.gate.bottle.van#one.
Reading card title on the mixer aisle's sealed crate, items unlocked by events. Capitals, one line.
Reading card title on the mixer aisle's sealed crate. {stars} is the nearest unlocking star rating. Capitals, one line.

strings.text: {n} mixer the van will not bring you yet
strings.note: Reading card second line on the mixer aisle's sealed crate. {n} is how many mixers are locked.

strings.text: {n} mixers the van will not bring you yet
strings.note: As market.gate.mixer.van#one.
Reading card title on the beer-keg aisle's sealed crate, kegs unlocked by the tap tower, not stars. Capitals, one line.
Reading card title on the keg aisle's sealed crate. {stars} is the nearest unlocking star rating. Capitals, one line.

strings.text: {n} keg the van will not bring you yet

strings.text: {n} kegs the van will not bring you yet
strings.note: As market.gate.keg.van#one.

Reading card title on the garnish tray's sealed crate. {stars} is the nearest unlocking star rating. Capitals, one line. 'GARNISHS' as always printed, see market.gate.garnish.to_earn.

strings.text: {n} garnish the van will not bring you yet
strings.note: Reading card second line on the garnish tray's sealed crate. {n} is how many garnishes are locked.

strings.note: As market.gate.garnish.van#one. The English 'garnishs' is what the game has always printed (noun + s); fix it in English only as a deliberate change.
Fallback for an aisle noun with no keys of its own (none today). {noun} is the aisle's noun in capitals. Translators: best effort.
Fallback, as market.gate.any.to_earn. {stars} is the nearest unlocking star rating.

strings.text: {n} {noun} the van will not bring you yet
strings.note: Fallback, as market.gate.any.to_earn. {noun} is the aisle's noun in lower case.

strings.note: As market.gate.any.van#one.
Reading card body on a sealed crate whose items unlock by events and whose locks gave no reason. One sentence.

strings.text: Get {stars} stars and more of these show up here.
strings.note: Reading card body on a star-gated sealed crate. {stars} is the nearest unlocking rating (e.g. 3.5). Wraps.
Reading card effect line (red lock) on a sealed crate that waits on events and gave no reason. One line.
Reading card effect line (red lock) on a star-gated sealed crate. {stars} is the rating needed, {have} the bar's current rating, both like 3.5. One line.

Upgrade screen rail key: pictures and screens hung on the wall. Capitals, 16 px, ~110 px, 2 lines at most.

Upgrade screen rail key: plants. Capitals, 16 px, ~110 px, 2 lines at most.
Upgrade screen rail key: pieces on the bar counter. Capitals, 16 px, ~110 px, 2 lines at most.

Section band on an upgrade shelf with no pieces in the data. Capitals, 16 px, one line.
Reading card title when hovering the rail's BAR & GLASS key. Capitals, one line ~30 characters.

strings.text: Nothing on this shelf can be bought tonight
strings.note: Reading card second line when hovering a rail key and nothing on that shelf is for sale tonight. One line.

strings.note: As decor.rail.open_count#one. {n} is 2 or more.

strings.text: Stools, the bar top and the glass lines. Each one uses the night's one upgrade.
strings.note: Reading card body when hovering the rail's BAR & GLASS key. Wraps.

strings.note: Reading card body when hovering any room shelf's rail key. Wraps.
Section band on the BAR & GLASS shelf over the stool and bar-top tiles. Capitals, 16 px, one line.
Market tile name for buying an extra bar stool (shown in capitals on the tile; also the basket's label and the refusal toast's item). Title case, 16 px, two lines of ~12 characters.
Market tile small meta line for the stool. {seat} is the seat this buys, {max} the room's maximum. ~16 characters.
Reading card title for the stool tile. Capitals, one line.
Reading card second line for the stool. {seat} is the seat this buys, {max} the maximum. One line.

strings.text: One more customer can sit at the bar.
strings.note: Reading card body for the stool. One sentence.
Reading card effect line (green star) for the stool. One line.
Reading card effect line (red lock) on stool, bar top and glassware: only one such fitting can be bought per night. One line.
Market tile name for upgrading the bar top (capitals on the tile; also basket label and toast item). Title case, 16 px, two lines of ~12 characters.

Market tile meta line for the bar top and each glassware line, and the start of the glassware reading card line (then ' · ' and a drink list). {rung} is the current upgrade level, {max} the top. ~16 characters.
Reading card title for the bar-top tile. Capitals, one line.
Reading card second line for the bar top. {rung} current level, {max} top level. One line.

strings.text: A better bar top makes every customer happier. Even the ones whose drink you get wrong.
strings.note: Reading card body for the bar top. Wraps.

strings.text: +0.03 on every served visit, up to +0.06
strings.note: Reading card effect line (green star) for the bar top: satisfaction bonus per served customer. One line.
Section band on the BAR & GLASS shelf over the glass-line tiles. Capitals, 16 px, one line.
Reading card title for a glass line upgrade. {glass} is the glass's name in capitals (e.g. HIGHBALL). Capitals, one line.

strings.text: Better glasses make every customer happier, and win you stars.
strings.note: Reading card body for a glass line upgrade. One sentence.

strings.text: +1 rung on the {glass} line · every drink served in one
strings.note: Reading card effect line (green star) for a glass line. {glass} is the glass's name in lower case (e.g. highball). One line.

strings.text: THE BAR IS FITTED — NOTHING LEFT TO RAISE
strings.note: Section band when the stools, bar top and every glass line are at their top. Capitals, 16 px, one line.
Right-hand status on an upgrade ladder's heading: no rung of this ladder is bought. Capitals, 8 px face, ~300 px.
Right-hand status on an upgrade ladder's heading, sometimes followed by '  ·  ' and what the rung is worth. {mark} is the highest rung bought, {total} the ladder's rung count. Capitals, 8 px.
What a room piece adds to the COMFORT rating: card fact line (shown in capitals), reading card effect line, ladder heading status (capitals). {comfort} is a number like 0.25. Short.
What a beer tower upgrade does: how many kegs it pours at once. Card fact line (capitals) and reading card effect line. {n} is 1-3.
As decor.tool.kegs_on_tap#one.
What a beer tower upgrade does. {percent} is a whole number (e.g. 25). Card fact line (capitals, ~22 characters at 8 px) and reading card effect line (may be followed by ' · ' and the keg count).
Card fact line for a sink upgrade (shown in capitals): how long washing a glass takes. {seconds} is a number like 2.5. ~22 characters at 8 px.
Reading card effect line for a sink upgrade. {seconds} is a number like 2.5; may be followed by ' · drains free'.
Appended after ' · ' to a sink's reading card effect line: pouring a drink away down this sink costs nothing. Lower case.
What a shaker upgrade does. {percent} is a whole number. Card fact line (capitals, ~22 characters) and reading card effect line.
Card fact line (capitals) for the starting shaker, which is no faster. ~22 characters at 8 px.
Reading card effect line for the starting shaker. One line.
Reading card second line for a room piece standing on the counter; may be followed by ' · mark 2 of 4'.
Reading card second line for a room piece; may be followed by ' · mark 2 of 4'.
Reading card second line after the place and ' · '. {mark} is this piece's rung, {total} the ladder's rung count. Lower case.
Reading card effect line (green star) for a room piece. {comfort} is decor.comfort already filled (e.g. '+0.25 comfort'); may follow a tool line and ' · '.

strings.text: In the room now · the room stays worth mark {mark}
strings.note: Reading card effect line on a lower rung the player is wearing while owning a higher one. {mark} is the highest rung bought. One line.
Reading card effect line on the piece currently standing in the room. One line.

strings.text: Bought already · wear it any night, free — the room stays worth mark {mark}
strings.note: Reading card effect line on an owned piece not on show (click WEAR to put it up). {mark} is the highest rung bought. Wraps to two lines.

strings.text: Fit mark {next} first · this bar is at mark {mark}
strings.note: Reading card effect line (red lock) on a rung that needs the rung below it. {next} is the rung to buy first, {mark} the rung owned now. One line.

strings.text: Needs a {stars}-star room · you are at {have}
strings.note: Reading card effect line (red lock) on a piece gated by the star rating. {stars} needed rating, {have} current rating, both like 3.5. One line.

strings.text: Never spends the night's one upgrade
strings.note: Reading card effect line (coin) on a buyable room piece: unlike stools and glassware it does not use the one-upgrade-a-night allowance. One line.
Corner stamp on an upgrade card whose piece is standing in the room now. Capitals, 8 px face, one short word.
Corner stamp on an upgrade card that is in the basket. Capitals, 8 px face, same words as the market tiles' in-basket stamp.
Corner stamp on an upgrade card that cannot be bought yet. Capitals, 8 px face, one short word.
Card fact line (shown in capitals) for a ladder rung with no tool or comfort value. {mark} is the rung number. ~22 characters at 8 px.
Card fact line (shown in capitals) for a piece the bar starts with. ~22 characters at 8 px.
Upgrade card foot beside a tick: this rung is the one standing in the room. Capitals, 8 px, ~110 px.
Upgrade card foot beside a tick: this single piece stands in the room. Capitals, 8 px, ~110 px.
Key on an owned upgrade card: put this piece up in the room instead of the current one. Capitals, 16 px face, 136 px key.
Upgrade card foot beside a lock: buy rung {mark} of this ladder before this one. Capitals, 8 px, ~110 px.
